correctness.rationale: Positive support separation gives the exact identity \(C_\mu(n)=\sum_i p_i^2C_i(n)\) for all sufficiently large \(n\). Invariance then reduces every same-component orbit count to its local law and makes cross-component two-orbit counts zero. The limit formulas and the contradiction \(1=\sum_i p_i^2<1\) follow algebraically.
